title: Derived scalar extension commutes with pro-etale slice restriction
statement: Let X be a scheme, U an object of its small pro-etale site, and f:R -> S a map of sheaves of commutative rings in the coefficient universe [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let res_R and res_S be exact derived slice restriction [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction], and let E_f and E_(f|U) be the universal total left derived scalar-extension functors [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] on X and on its slice [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Then res_R followed by E_(f|U) is naturally isomorphic to E_f followed by res_S. The definitions completedAdicSliceChangeData and completedAdicSliceDerivedChange use the actual universal scalar-extension witness on the slice, with standard derived localizations. No boundedness, adic datum, nonempty chart, or constant-module hypothesis occurs.

source.place: lemma-derived-base-change (06YY), lemma-pullback-K-flat (0G7E), and lemma-derived-pullback-composition (0D6D), specialized to localization of a ringed site

proof.text: Resolve an arbitrary complex of R-modules by a flat-term K-flat complex. Its restriction to the localization site is again flat-term K-flat: localization is a morphism of ringed topoi and the coefficient map is the identity of the restricted ring.

Ordinary extension along f followed by restriction to U agrees with restriction followed by extension along f|U. On V -> U the presheaf tensor is S(V) tensor over R(V) with the module sections. Module sheafification commutes with localization: the covering sieves of V -> U are precisely the covering sieves of V. The sheafification universal property identifies the two functors and all their maps.

The universal counits of the supplied derived-change data are invertible on these K-flat representatives. Exact derived slice restriction agrees with localization of termwise restriction. Compose these comparisons and descend their naturality through the K-flat representative localization to obtain the natural isomorphism.

theorem completedAdic_slice_scalarComparison (X : Scheme.{t}) (U : X.ProEt)
    {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1}} (f : R ⟶ S) :
    Nonempty
      (ringedDerivedRestrictionGeneral
          ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R) U ⋙
          completedAdicSliceDerivedChange X U f ≅
        completedAdicDerivedChange X f ⋙
          ringedDerivedRestrictionGeneral
            ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
              (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj S) U)
